title: Clinic+ — Dual-Cloud SaaS Infrastructure & AI Platform
problem: Healthcare SaaS platform required strict staging/production isolation across two clouds, with zero-downtime releases and a production AI workload behind secure gateways.
solution: Architected Hetzner Cloud staging alongside GCP production — GKE, GCS, Secret Manager, Cloud Load Balancing, Cloud DNS, Cloud IAM, and Cloud Armor rate limiting. Built GitHub Actions with self-hosted runners for container builds, forward-only DB migrations, and zero-downtime GKE rollouts.
outcome: Production-grade dual-cloud platform with hardened workloads (health probes, RBAC, Cloud Monitoring) and a live AI Medical Assistant in production.

title: Al Rajhi Bank — Enterprise Archiving System (Tawtheeq)
problem: Top-tier bank needed a compliant, repeatable deployment model for an enterprise archiving platform across DEV, SIT, UAT, and PROD under strict financial regulatory requirements.
solution: Managed Red Hat OpenShift (OKD) clusters with Kubernetes network isolation, secret management integrations, RBAC, and Keycloak SSO. Designed GitLab CI/CD pipelines with container compliance scanning before every production deployment.
outcome: Audit-compliant, repeatable pipeline delivering regulated archiving infrastructure without exposing internal system details.

title: Saudi Ministry System — Air-Gapped GIS & GPU Infrastructure
problem: Legacy GIS platform required modernization in a fully air-gapped government environment, including AI/GPU capacity and zero-trust ingress/egress controls.
solution: Architected containerized GIS microservices on air-gapped Kubernetes with isolated network boundaries and internal DNS. Automated GPU cluster node provisioning and bare-metal software stacks using Python, Terraform, and Ansible.
outcome: Modernized, secured, automation-first infrastructure at scale — from legacy GIS to containerized microservices with GPU compute.

title: Production Observability Stack
problem: Hybrid Hetzner and GCP infrastructure lacked unified observability — cross-service outages were detected late and root cause was slow to identify.
solution: Deployed Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, and Alertmanager alongside GCP Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging for distributed metrics, centralized log aggregation, and actionable alerting across hybrid workloads.
outcome: Improved cross-service outage detection and faster incident identification across hybrid production infrastructure.
